stories.title: Power cut hits part of Sandycroft with supply due back by 1.30pm
stories.summary: Part of Sandycroft is without power this morning after an unplanned power cut, with SP Energy Networks aiming to restore supplies by 1.24pm.

stories.title: Power cut hits part of Holywell with supply due back by 3pm

stories.title: Announcements do not get people to work: MS demands dates for £20m Flintshire bus plan
stories.summary: The First Minister has said improved bus links to Deeside Industrial Park will move into implementation by the end of the 2027-28 financial year.

stories.title: Some DWP online services offline after cyber incident, but benefit payments not affected
stories.summary: Some Department for Work and Pensions (DWP) online services have been taken offline after a cyber incident. stories.title: Blackmail is most common crime linked to Instagram in North Wales, police figures show
stories.summary: Blackmail is the most common crime linked to Instagram in North Wales this year, police figures show. North Wales Police, which covers Flintshire, has listed 65 occurrences recorded in 2026 where Instagram was mentioned in the occurrence summary. Of those, 27 were recorded as blackmail. The figures were released under the Freedom of Information Act
